text: Could you take the candle in this pic and move it onto a pale kitchen counter, because I’m trying to picture it in a setting that feels more natural? I always worry that moving a product into a different background will make it look pasted in rather than actually photographed there. Please keep the jar and wax the same, and make the image square with no text. The sunlight should be warm and come from the upper left. I mean that the light on the glass and the shadow on the counter should both match that sunlight, so the candle looks like it was actually photographed on that counter.
